headword: {年|ねん}がら{年中|ねんじゅう}
gloss: all year round; all the time

definitions.gloss: all year round; all the time; constantly
definitions.explanation: Throughout the whole year without a break; an emphatic, casual way of saying something never stops.

examples.japanese: {年|ねん}がら{年中|ねんじゅう}⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年|ねん}がら{年中|ねんじゅう}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My brother plays games all the time.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年|ねん}がら{年中|ねんじゅう}{風|かぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}くて→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧、⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{飛|と}ばされる→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧。
examples.english: It's windy around here all year, so the laundry keeps getting blown away.

notes:
An emphatic, casual form of ⟦{年中|ねんじゅう}→年中：00311_nenjuu⟧. It often carries a note of complaint or exasperation.
